item.title: DevMemory: A Structured Memory Management Architecture for Persistent Knowledge in AI Coding Agents
item.description: AI coding agents operate without persistent memory; useful outputs produced in one session are unavailable in the next, and information from one project never transfers to another. item.title: BenchShield: Formal Model-Backed Instrumentation for Reward Integrity in LLM-Agent Evaluation Infrastructure
item.description: LM-agent benchmarks increasingly function as interactive evaluation infrastructure. Agents observe state, call tools, modify workspaces, submit artifacts, and receive rewards from outcome procedures. item.description: Abstract This study investigates whether increasing digital intensity actually improves heritage tourism experiences, or whether the real value driver is how well technology is integrated with the tour guide. item.title: EXTENDING ST-T1024 TO BE AGENTIC: SAFETY AS GUARANTEE, From Deterministic Oracle to Certified Actor
item.description: ST-T1024, as specified, is a deterministic oracle. It answers. It refuses when uncertain. It is bounded, verifiable, and sovereign — but it does not act. This paper specifies an architectural extension: agency. We propose an FSM-based action pipeline, a ROM-burned action library, a tile invocation protocol, persistent deterministic memory, and a dedicated VERIFY state that gates every action before it is committed. The central claim is stated plainly: In stochastic systems, agency is the danger.
